search_window.basis: Since latest verified 13:47:57 PST Food Line heartbeat. Targeted web searches limited to 12, with 2-3 day recency to account for delayed indexing; qualifying events limited to new and nonduplicate developments in the observation window.

coverage_notes.purpose: Bounded supplementary U.S. Food Line recall watch; authoritative primary nationwide collector not accessed or changed.
target_classes: Loss of only/sole/last/full-service grocery via fire, flooding, closure or other disaster

reviewed_exclusions.reason: McCaysville, Georgia's sole grocery store flood loss occurred earlier in November and was recorded in previous watch heartbeats; no new separate loss.
Provo, Utah Community Action Services and Food Bank closure was announced October 31 and effective November 1, already recorded; not new this hour.
November 6 hurricane-recovery article explicitly lists the Hale Līhuʻe mobile pantry distribution as scheduled. Closure applies to hurricane resource centers, not this food distribution.
Previously known, undated SNAP interview and phone processing delays; no new official benefits interruption with immediate access effect.
November 5–6 offices closed for maintenance/festival, and October 30 network outage expired; no new November 7 SNAP/EBT interruption.
November 6 WIC transaction/online-ordering rule is modernization, not an acute loss of food-assistance access.
November 2025 SNAP government-shutdown stories, older grocery closures, Canadian news, donation/promotional stories are stale or outside scope.

other_tool_limitations: GitHub public HTML directory view was unavailable through web browsing; current branch changes were checked with authenticated GitHub compare_commits and previous heartbeat fetched through GitHub connector instead.
coverage_notes.assessment: No newly verifiable, nonduplicate U.S. disruption in the four high-value miss classes was found since 13:47:57 PST. Twelve targeted web searches yielded older/unrelated and already-reviewed incidents; five direct source checks established no new immediate interruption.
coverage_notes.limitations: This bounded supplementary indexed-web review may miss hyperlocal same-hour notices, unindexed provider social updates or delays in search indexing. Production collection and production deduplication were not inspected; production remains authoritative.
coverage_notes.action_limits: Append-only single heartbeat on ops/watch-ledger; no publication, approval, schedule changes or disabling.
